topic: Template Function Operator Overloading for std::array Inequality
explanation: This concept, specifically the inequality operator (!=) for the standard container std::array. By defining a template function, we enable comparison operations between arrays of any element type T and size N, leveraging C++'s template system to write generic, type-safe code that works across different instantiations of std::array. This approach exemplifies modern C++'s emphasis on generic programming, enabling flexible and reusable code components.
